name: Low-Carb Chicken, Bacon and Broccoli Cauliflower Bake
why: Textbook chicken-bake for the lane: a crustless casserole bound with eggs and cheddar over a riced-cauliflower and broccoli base - no rice/pasta/potato. Published 457 cal / 6g carbs / 45g protein per serving sits squarely mid-band and high-protein. All main ingredients (cauliflower, broccoli, chicken breast, bacon, shredded cheddar, eggs) map to the board; only dry mustard powder is unmapped. Weigh-and-divide bake scales cleanly to 14 servings.
confidence: high - read published nutrition directly from source page
